title: Katori Shinto Ryu - Bukijutsu Sword Style
body:
Syntax: SWORDSTYLE Katori Shinto Ryu | SWORDSTYLE LIST | SWORDSTYLE OFF

Katori Shinto Ryu unlocks for Bukijutsu at level 110 and is learned automatically at that level. Disciplined all-round swordsmanship with balanced strikes. Wield one sword to use it.

At 100% mastery: +10 accuracy and +12% sword damage. Each landed strike costs 3 Stamina. Bonuses increase with mastery, starting at a partial strength. Use PRAC <school name> with a teacher for your initial lesson and improve it by landing ordinary sword attacks while selected. Only one sword school may be active at a time; its selection persists across logins. See HELP SWORDSTYLE for the full list.
